title: Conditional κ = 0.003637417119941 (+9.6926221e-7 over #7110)
body:
This splits a second independent rank-nine helper on exact #7110 into rank-five and rank-four jobs, raising conditional **κ from .003636447857731 to .003637417119941**: an absolute gain of **.000000969262210**. It adds one research package. The selected frontier is unchanged.

The new witness uses chart 118, pivot 631 and source cut 37738. The legacy basis routine would choose d3=677/163840 and require an unsupported denominator 677. Choosing d641=−1/4 instead keeps every emitted coefficient and inverse SCALE in the existing 2,3,5 alphabet. The whole prefix/suffix identities, arbitrary inputs and source/target charts are checked. All 872 ADDs and 6 SCALEs are charged; no MOVE is added.

- Complete invoice delta: productive `{4:+18,5:+18,9:−18}`, paid unchanged; surplus 1,520 and zero empty-root credit.
- Ordinary source-unit bill: **848,738,320 <10^9**, including the actual signed caller routes, scalar surcharge and conversions.
- Independent raw bracket: `(.00363741711994152260052497254765289, .00363741711994152260052497254765290)`. The complete #7110 invoice rejects the new claim.
- Fresh rational derivation and independent integer replay retain odd scale 1125, fractional height 24 and signed-caller precision c1342. Lower scale 375 and height 23 reject.
- Exact source: #7110 head `fdb1eb55c4c6604e714c6950e656c67ae0e52370`; emitted word SHA256 `3454c4900245ed1814ceeff79a741a45160eb3a93cf8d15f891fe2a67ba036fc`.

Two complete local CPython 3.14.7 runs passed, including the final frozen receipt with all controls: exact cut and forward/adjoint endpoints, all 512 columns and phase of the split maps, complete signed caller/prices/precision/compiler and 54+4 outer gates, full finite physical word and signed routes. Metadata, committed bytes, modes and canonical research-source ancestry passed. Hosted CI is currently blocked before package replay by an upstream documentation mismatch: canonical main's CI guide still names #6030 after selection moved to #7000. A minimal canonical-base correction passes all six current-status/navigation tests locally. It is handed off below; including that changed historical file in the stale-fork transport created a merge conflict, so the PR remains package-only. No hosted Python 3.12 scientific pass is claimed. A complete additional local **CPython 3.12.16** replay now passes with every frozen receipt field equal, including physical native and signed-route checks. It used the official Astral python-build-standalone release20261026, archive SHA256 `fbf4afef53c2a6b72bb741bc06d5671a9dfaf87bd84e5aa73ac9b3d0d589f14e`, extracted into temporary storage; system Python was unchanged. Command: `/tmp/kappa-python312/python/bin/python3.12 -I -B /tmp/p104-source7112/package/verify.py`. The copied package is the unchanged public scientific tree. Reproduce with:

```
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-smooth-swap-split
```

The current selected #7000 application was read at canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; priority revision 8 is unchanged. A separately reproduced first rank-nine gain overlapped #7110 and was preserved locally instead of submitted. This PR checks a distinct second direction on exact public #7110. The final source-overlap refresh found no existing #7110 successor in the searched PR bodies; this is coverage evidence, not a novelty proof. [Canonical investigation and bounded negative screens](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19520521).

The five retained assumptions and complete changed-source occurrence/storage/root/physical-cost application remain obligations. Passing finite checks and source-unit costs do not establish a complete multiplier, physical tariff conversion, independent human review or formal-kernel proof. The #7000 admission applies to its exact source, not automatically to this successor. Open next questions are in README.md and TASK.json.

Credit Ali Romman for helper/basis splitting; Jerry Chen/CubeJerry for inventories, retiming, shared-wire/caller/BIT and precision; DreamingOfClouds for the native lineage; ToikY for #7003/#7004 and exact #7108/#7109/#7110; #7105/#7107 and all retained original notices. Prepared for dillona with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents.

Publication transport: the canonical-base research commit is `b809a979e5745682e2ec84e26791dc99b61991f4`. The account token cannot synchronize historical workflow changes to the fork, so the public commit contains only this package atop the existing fork parent `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. Its 19-file package tree `40e91c177e5976d030325728d42ee38a3a86ae8e` is byte- and mode-identical to the canonical-base research commit. No workflow files are changed.

Current publication head: `e59520bb11b0df5ac33f062f55397d78a491e7af`. Its entire tree matches initial package-only head `b0d252a2552fad8211de79c70026ca150a56da0c`; all 19 package files are unchanged. The tested CI-navigation correction is preserved in canonical-base commit `096553d6fe37afee7bc66470f4bbacf0cffbb3a3` locally, and its [exact public file](https://github.com/dillona/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e7ba6f19575a1036aa938c8f1bed703f7345efc0/docs/ci-verification.md) is available for a maintainer to apply to canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`.
